records.label: definitive_change_of_control_announcement
records.review_notes: Amgen and Nasdaq FPRX announce a board-approved merger agreement at $38 cash per share. The terms call for a tender for every outstanding common share, followed by a merger converting untendered shares to the same cash price. Source-reviewed by Codex; not independently adjudicated by a human. Date is the sourced definitive-announcement calendar date; intraday publication time and exhaustive earliest-publication search were not established. Status is pending as described at announcement, not a present-day deal-status claim. Control percent means proposed post-transaction ownership, not acceptance threshold or the incremental stake purchased. Announcement evidence is a label only, never a pre-event feature.
records.review_scope: Definitive whole-company acquisition public announcement, jointly checked against complete disclosed merger chronology. Date-only precision retained; no exhaustive independent first-news search.
records.source_title: Amgen To Acquire Five Prime Therapeutics For $1.9 Billion in Cash
